title: Hold a labour hire licence
what: Provide labour hire services (supplying workers to do work for other businesses) only while holding a labour hire licence.

sources.title: Labour Hire Licensing Act 2017 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not provide labour hire services unless the person is the holder of a licence

administration.who: Chief executive of the department administering the Labour Hire Licensing Act 2017 (Qld)

sources.title: Labour Hire Licensing Act 2017 (Qld)
sources.locator: s 14, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: The chief executive may grant an application for a licence only if the chief executive is satisfied— (a) each of the following persons are fit and proper persons to provide labour hire services— (i) each applicant;

reach.condition: if it supplies its workers to do work for other businesses (labour hire services, as the Act defines them)
